subject: planer: fix invalid pointer caused by a recursive CTE query (#54450)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: the only runtime change is `pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go` `findBestTask4LogicalCTETable` now returns `base.InvalidTask` (non-nil) instead of `nil` when child required property has sort items, preventing nil `Task` from reaching `Attach2Task` during physical plan enumeration and causing a panic for recursive CTE queries. Added executor regression test and minor test infra tweaks. Checked upstream/master: the CTETable FindBestTask logic was refactored but still rejects non-empty sort requirements with `base.InvalidTask` (plus extra guards), so this fix pattern persists.
